lines: hook
Real or fake? Here's why the fake might actually win.
price
A designer bag can cost three thousand dollars. A good replica? About a hundred.
closet
But a bag you're scared to use just sits in the closet.
wear
Think cost per wear. Carry the replica every day for a year, and it's less than thirty cents a wear.
fearless
Concerts. Airports. Rainy days. It goes everywhere, with zero stress.
test
It's also the cheapest way to test a style. Try the look for a hundred, before you ever commit three thousand.
lost
And if it's stolen, or lost on a trip? You're out a hundred dollars, not a month's pay.
resale
People call designer bags an investment. But most resell for less than you paid.
seen
And at the end of the day, nobody sees the receipt. They just see how you carry it.
end
So keep the look, and keep the money. Real or fake: which would you pick?
